title: Don't Be Bothered
vol: Mommy Is Human Too · Book Eight

pages.text:
Uncle came to visit, and Jojo felt his jaw get tight.
Everything Uncle did was wrong; nothing felt quite right.

The toys must line up by size. Breakfast is at 7 AM sharp.
The couch pillows must match exactly. His rules cut like a harp.

How can Uncle love us all, if rules come first, and play comes last?
If everything must be so rigid, how does love hold fast?

Mommy took Jojo's hand and sat. "Let me tell you a story true —
about your Uncle and his heart, and what shaped the man he grew into.

Your Uncle served his country. He wore a uniform with pride.
But when chaos came — when times got hard and soldiers cried —

his mind learned that order meant survival. Structure meant he'd stay alive.
So now your Uncle builds control in everything — it's how he knows to thrive."

"There is a verse," said Mommy, "that I want you now to know:
Love is patient, love is kind. This is how true love will grow.

Love does not say, 'You must be like me, or I will turn away.'
Love says, 'I see who you are. I know you. And I choose you anyway.'"

Later, Pip came to Jojo, frustrated and feeling small:
"Jojo, Uncle yelled at me for moving the toys off the wall!"

Then Jojo — with a wisdom deeper than his seven years — took his sister's hand:
"Pip, the Bible says to know the ones you labour with. Let me help you understand.

Uncle wasn't angry AT you, Pip. He was angry at the chaos all around.
His mind says order keeps him safe. That's how his peace is found.

There's a time to play, and a time to respect what others need.
When Uncle asks us to keep things ordered, that's how we plant love's seed.

Loving people isn't always easy. But it means you learn their way.
You don't have to be like Uncle — but you honor him today."

So Jojo loved his Uncle by meeting him where he stands,
and taught his sister that unconditional love means: I see you. I understand.

verses: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up.
To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering.
Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another.
